admission.justification: A future preference refactor must not let one temporary passage action silently rewrite saved global presentation.

applicability: The recorded reviewer/reader 6 choice of MIK-R67@v2 rule18, or the explicit F07 resource ruling for one-spilled-history.
conditions: Persist the general layout preference only; keep a passage Show inline override local to that passage.
The general preference is shared/saved, whereas the temporary override is for the passage on screen.
exclusions: The preference module owns global persistence; the passage renderer owns the transient override, and storage failures remain tolerated.
This is a source-bound future boundary, not a fresh runtime, visual, suite or independent MEMORY verdict.
statement: "Show inline" for one rewritten passage is not saved. The general layout preference is saved; the override is for the passage on screen.
